title: Probabilistic Machine Learning for Total Kinetic Energy Distributions in Neutron-Induced Fission
abstract: arXiv:2611.33379v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The incident-neutron-energy dependence of post-neutron total-kinetic-energy (TKE) distributions, particularly their width in the multichance-fission regime, provides a sensitive test of fission calculations. We investigate how the General Description of Fission Observables (GEF) and probabilistic machine-learning models trained on GEF reproduce measured TKE distributions, emphasizing their width at high incident-neutron energies and extrapolation beyond the training range. Gaussian process regression (GPR), GPR with a white-noise kernel, a mixture density network (MDN), and a Bayesian mixture density network (BMDN) are evaluated on a common calculated dataset. An extended MDN/BMDN analysis uses 1,025 GEF spectra from 20 target nuclei and 60 measured distributions. Training ranges of up to 20, 40, and approximately 76 MeV are compared with matched-size controls extending to 30 or 40 MeV while preserving the number of spectra per target.

translated_title: 中子诱发裂变中总动能分布的概率机器学习研究
translated_abstract: 裂变后中子发射的总动能（TKE）分布对入射中子能量的依赖性，特别是其在多机会裂变区域的宽度，为裂变计算提供了一个敏感的检验手段。我们研究了裂变观测量通用描述模型（GEF）以及在GEF数据上训练的概率机器学习模型如何重现测量的TKE分布，重点关注其在高入射中子能量下的宽度以及在训练范围之外的外推能力。我们在一个共同的计算数据集上评估了高斯过程回归（GPR）、带白噪声核的高斯过程回归、混合密度网络（MDN）和贝叶斯混合密度网络（BMDN）。扩展的MDN/BMDN分析使用了来自20个靶核的1,025个GEF能谱和60个实测分布。研究比较了最多20、40和约76 MeV的训练范围与匹配规模的对照组（扩展至30或40 MeV），同时保持每个靶核的能谱数量不变。
tldr: 该论文利用高斯过程回归和（贝叶斯）混合密度网络等概率机器学习模型，系统评估了其重现中子诱发裂变总动能分布宽度（尤其在高入射中子能量下）以及在训练范围之外外推的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates probabilistic machine learning models—including Gaussian process regression and (Bayesian) mixture density networks—for reproducing total kinetic energy distributions in neutron-induced fission, focusing on capturing distribution widths at high incident neutron energies and extrapolating beyond the training range.
